shared_elements: figures with limbs shown in profile/schematic outline
long straight incised lines crossing the field
carving cut into a natural stone surface
justification: Both are stone surfaces bearing schematic limbed figures and long straight linear elements, and in each case a figure appears to hold or be crossed by an elongated bar-like line, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a modelled low relief organised into stacked horizontal registers on a shaped upright block, while B is a shallow pecked, purely linear scatter of outlines with no register structure or volumetric modelling.
